elevate.move: Give the mono voice to the drawing only: every tracked caps string becomes a drawn annotation on a hairline with a tick (hour tags, dimensions, spot elevations), and all UI/meta labels (review tags, eyebrows, form labels) move to Geist sentence case, so the page has two registers, drawn and spoken.

Make the photographs the result the drawings promise: choose the approved frame closest to a deck or rail on a slope for the hero plate with the drawn grade landing on its real ground edge, and end the story's 9 PM step on a full-width duotone photo revealed through the finished deck outline as the drawing fades.
